text: The Prover, through the door in the List's right-hand wall as you come in.
Feed cards 12 and 47 to the Prover, and watch what it does with each.
The last room. A machine that proves things, and some numbered cards. Read the plaque on your right.
Press a card on the desk to feed it to the Prover. Start with cards 12 and 47.
Watch the board: the Prover finds a proof of 2 + 2 = 4 and stamps the card.
Card 81 says the Prover can't prove some card. Set its number so it talks about itself, then feed it in.
2 + 2 = 5 is false. The Prover will never find a proof of it, so it searches forever.
Now card 81. Its number can be changed with the button on the right of the desk.
Card 81 says: “The Prover can't prove card 81.” It's talking about itself. Watch what the Prover does.
Answer the questions on the left-hand wall about card 81.
The lectern on the left-hand wall has woken up. Can the Prover ever prove card 81?
Right. If it proved card 81, it would have proved something false, and it never does. So it never will.
True. It says the Prover can't prove it, and that is exactly so. True, and it can't be proved.
Every loop found. Turn round: the Prover's board shows why card 81 is true.

title: True, and it can't be proved.
